name: posthog-js-extensions
description: Subpath entry point exposing the pre-grouped extension bundles that posthog-js/slim composes with: session replay, analytics autocapture, feature flags, error tracking, product tours and site apps. Pass the bundles a site uses through the __extensionClasses config and a bundler keeps the rest out. ESM-only; consumed by bundlers via the `module` field.
